question_text: A local government employee posts a defamatory statement about a private citizen on a public Facebook group. The citizen wants to file a complaint under RA 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act). Which of the following is correct regarding the offense of cyber libel?

options.text: The employee cannot be held liable because the post was made outside of office hours and not using government equipment.
The employee can be held liable for cyber libel, and the penalty is one degree higher than libel under the Revised Penal Code.
The employee can only be charged if the post was shared more than 100 times.
The employee is immune from suit because the post is considered an exercise of freedom of speech.
